Maintainer and authors

Carrie Daymont developed and maintains the child and adult algorithms. Other authors implemented the algorithm in R (converting it from its initial implementation in Stata statistical software), added associated utility functions, and developed the Shiny app.

  • Carrie Daymont
  • Robert W Grundmeier
  • Jeffrey Miller
  • Diego Campos
  • Dan Chudnov
  • Hannah De los Santos
  • David Freedman
  • Wen Hu
  • Chris Penney

Funding and organizations

The current release of growthcleanr was funded by the HHS Office of the Secretary Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Trust Fund (OS-PCORTF) and supported by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Division of Nutrition, Physical Activity, and Obesity. Original development of growthcleanr was supported in large part by the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) Pediatric Research in Office Settings (PROS) network, including with data provided by the AAP PROS Comparative Effectiveness Research through Collaborative Electronic Reporting (CER2) electronic health record data network. The Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia contributed data and programming support. The University of Manitoba and Penn State College of Medicine provided salary support, and Penn State Health Golisano Children’s Hospital contributed data.
